basis.saw: a screenshot of the WHO/UNICEF Joint Reporting Form instructions

narrative.text: A screenshot of the opening of the WHO/UNICEF Joint Reporting Form on Immunization: 'Annual Report on Immunization Performance for the Period January-December 2016 from Ministry of Health <<Country Name>> to WHO/UNICEF'. Instructions say to enter NR if a question is not relevant, ND if no data are available, and 0 if the number of cases is zero; that blue cells provide drop-down lists; and that earlier data are available from WHO and UNICEF web addresses. Listed among the WHO guidance this kit draws on as a sample of the joint report form.
